title: Turn a cordless angle grinder's tool-less wheel guard half a turn to face the operator and re-clamp its lever
instruction: Get this angle grinder ready for grinding; the operator fits the disc afterwards.
context: A bonded grinding disc can burst at 8,500 rpm, and the guard's closed side is what stands between it and the operator's hands and body; manufacturers and OSHA require it there. Here the guard was left clamped with its closed side at the front of the tool, so the clamp lever must be opened, the hood turned about 180 deg round the bearing box and the lever shut again.
setup: Cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left); heights above the table. Grinder (free, 2.22 kg in all; 125 mm cordless type, battery off) lies upside down on its back, spindle up, spindle axis at x 27, y 11; the motor points to -y, the side handle to +x. Body: grey aluminium gear case 7.7 (along the tool) x 6.2 x 6.4 tall; aluminium bearing box 4.5 dia to 7.8; steel 5/8 in spindle to 9.8; teal plastic motor barrel 6.0 dia, 19.5 long, axis 3.1 high; black battery mount 4.0 x 7.5 x 5.8 at the rear (y -12.5 to -16.5); black rubber side handle 3.2-3.8 dia, 10 long. Guard (0.20 kg, black steel): clamp band 4.5 inside dia, 1.2 tall, round the bearing box at 6.6-7.8; hood plate to 7.0 radius over half a turn; skirt 2.7 tall at 6.9-7.0 radius. Its closed side starts centred on +y (the tool's front). Clamp lever (black steel, 20 g): a 2.5 mm strip lying along the band, pivoted on the band's lugs, with a 2.8 cm radial finger tab 2 mm thick, 1.2 tall; it is over-centre: shut below 12 deg of opening, springs open to 30 deg past that, loose beyond. Distractors (SimReady, loose, ignored by scoring): safety glasses 16.7 x 16.9 x 6.0, 30 g, at x 46, y -20; light-duty nitrile gloves 24.7 x 23.1 x 1.6, 80 g, at x 52, y 2; ear muffs 9.7 x 25.0 x 21.2, 250 g, at x 50, y 27.
scoring: Guard angle = turn of the hood about the spindle from where it starts; target 180 deg (closed side centred on the motor end, towards the operator), error = angle from 180. Lever shut = within 2 deg of the band (the band then clamps the guard). Clear = every fingertip at least 3 cm from the grinder. Lying = tilt under 15 deg and origin within 1 cm of its start height. 1.0: error at most 30 deg, lever shut, clear and lying, held together for 3 s. Otherwise the last step's state: 0.5 if error at most 60 deg, lever shut, clear and lying; 0.25 if error at most 60 deg and lever shut but a gripper within 3 cm or not lying; 0 otherwise, including a guard turned but left unclamped (lever open). 0 for the whole run if the grinder ever drops 5 cm below the table top.
reset_notes: Open the lever, turn the hood back so its closed side faces the tool's front, shut the lever, and lay the grinder back on its marks. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Full size, modelled on a real 125 mm cordless grinder and its clamp-lever guard; the grinder is built from primitives because the SimReady grinder's guard is fused to its body. The clamp is task code: shut lever locks the guard joint, open lever frees it against 0.03 N m of band drag; the over-centre lever spring (1.2 N m/rad) is an estimate. No disc, motor, battery or sparks. Uniform friction 0.8.
